newsitem.title: ITALY: Pope in Paris in August for World Day of Youth.
newsitem.headline: Pope in Paris in August for World Day of Youth.

text.p: Pope John Paul will make a four-day trip to Paris in August to celebrate the Roman Catholic Church's World Day of Youth, the Vatican said on Wednesday.
The Pontiff will arrive in Paris on August 21, travel to the nearby town of Evry for a one-day visit on August 22, remain in Paris on August 23 and return to Rome on August 24.
It will be the 79th foreign trip for the 77-year-old Pope, who returned earlier this month from an 11-day pilgrimage to his Polish homeland.
